automatic_embedding_eligibility.license_evidence_required: if true, license_evidence_object_key and license_evidence_sha256 must both be non-null immutable fields

unknown_rule: Missing, malformed, false, contradictory, campaign-restricted or attribution-required rights never grant V1 automatic embedding.
campaign_restriction_rule: Any non-null allowed_uses.campaign_restriction is ineligible in V1 because no approved deterministic compatibility evaluator exists.
attribution_rule: Attribution-required assets may remain catalogued but are ineligible for V1 automated render-safe embedding; no implicit posting attribution workflow is assumed.
license_evidence_rule: license_url_or_reference is the frozen human-readable canonical license reference. When allowed_uses.license_evidence_required=true, immutable license_evidence_object_key + license_evidence_sha256 are mandatory evidence; provenance_notes alone never satisfies the requirement.
manifest_verification: exact membership in committed audio plan

asset_versioning.reactivation: forbidden in place; create a new asset id/version
asset_versioning.historical_rule: Existing render manifests retain immutable asset id/SHA/license provenance even after later deactivation.
